DT_Stack.name: The Stack
DT_Stack.text: Vertically layered near-future megacity defined primarily by social stratification, access, status, citizenship, culture and personhood. Physical infrastructure supports the setting but should not dominate the storytelling. Visual inspiration: sophisticated, socially legible future-city worlds in the vein of Altered Carbon, with Snowpiercer-style class contrast and Hunger Games-style clarity of privilege and control. Different groups inhabit visibly different social realities within the same city; those differences must not map simplistically onto species or category.

DT_OrganicDistricts.name: Organic Districts
DT_OrganicDistricts.text: Neighborhoods where Organics live, work, repair, socialize and build community. Treat them as lived social environments with their own aesthetics, status, relationships and internal variety—not as machinery zones or industrial warrens.

DT_GovernanceUpperLevels.name: Governance Upper Levels
DT_GovernanceUpperLevels.text: Controlled civic and corporate upper levels with cleaner architecture, access barriers, surveillance and procedural order. Emphasize social privilege, institutional power, ease and exclusion more than literal engineering or technical systems.
